description: This file implements the gl::Buffer class, managing OpenGL buffer objects including data storage, mapping, copying, and state management within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: BufferState
classes.description: Holds the internal state of a buffer, including label, usage, size, access flags, mapping status, and binding counts.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL buffer object, providing methods for data management, mapping, copying, and state notifications.

methods.name: BufferState()
methods.description: Constructor initializing buffer state with default values.

methods.name: Buffer()
methods.description: Constructor creating a Buffer object with a factory and ID.

methods.name: onDestroy()
methods.description: Destroys the buffer implementation if it exists.

methods.name: setLabel()
methods.description: Sets the label for the buffer.

methods.name: getLabel()
methods.description: Returns the label of the buffer.

methods.name: bufferData()
methods.description: Allocates and initializes buffer data, with support for robust resource init.

methods.name: bufferSubData()
methods.description: Updates a subset of buffer data.

methods.name: mapRange()
methods.description: Maps a range of the buffer for writing.

methods.name: getIndexRange()
methods.description: Retrieves the index range for drawing, using cache if available.

methods.name: getMemorySize()
methods.description: Returns the memory size of the buffer.

methods.name: isDoubleBoundForTransformFeedback()
methods.description: Checks if buffer is double bound for transform feedback.

methods.name: onTFBindingChanged()
methods.description: Updates binding counts for transform feedback.
